verdict.rationale: Anrok ships an AI assistant (AI Atlas), so letting it plug in external MCP servers as a client is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows it can do this. The 'hand it to your agents' Headless Tax messaging describes Anrok being used by external agents, the opposite direction, and does not count toward this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
